findings.description: _drain stage running used effective constraints while ACOM anchor remains original null/{}; memory replay refuses immutable mismatch. Must stage original constraints and test real drain.

Provider return can be lost if pinned source changes during call: self.task revalidates live pins before result_ready and again in exception handler. Persist returned result without post-call live-source dependency; replay must never repeat call.

Exact bind replay unnecessarily revalidates mutable board before looking up committed binding. Legitimate board change invalidates idempotent replay. Verify stored custody on replay, current board only at initial bind.

scope: Candidate source review only. No production mutation or external provider/Work call. Snapshot taken while builder edits; findings refer inspected pre-fix code, final review remains required.
